data.summary:
Done — "Blue Hour" jazz night poster, built as an editable system and exported at both sizes.

**Design.** Deep night-blue ground (#0A1430), warm off-white ink (#F2EEE3), one amber accent (#F2A03C) for the lantern light, labels and the free-entry badge. Inter Display Black title in a tight two-line stack with an amber full stop, Inter ExtraBold for the details, JetBrains Mono for the small caps labels. The illustration (illo.svg) is three shapes only: a lantern on a cord inside a dashed ring of light, and a moon rising behind four horizon lines, cropped by the right edge, its base landing exactly on the footer rule. Both sheets share theme.css, so one system drives both formats; the Instagram version is re-set for the 4:5 crop rather than scaled.

**Exports.** A3 print PDF: 313 × 436 mm page = 297 × 420 mm A3 trim with 3 mm bleed and crop marks, one page, vector, fonts embedded. Instagram PNG: exactly 1080 × 1350.

**Checked.** Contrast measured (ink on night 15.7:1, amber on night 8.5:1, night on amber badge 8.5:1, 70 % ink 8.0:1 — all above WCAG AA). PDF page size, single page and embedded fonts verified; the PDF was rasterised and inspected inside the trim box; the Instagram file was checked at 100 % and at phone width (390 px), where the title, date, time, venue and badge all stay legible. Both files are open in the browser on the desktop, side by side at http://localhost:8137/proof.html.
